performance.verdict: ROAS collapse is real; purchase signal too thin to trust any single week.

findings.text: ROAS fell 47% WoW to ~3.45 on 28d; last 3 days (Aug 22–24) show 2 purchases on $151.53 spend vs 5 purchases on $163.20 in prior 3 days — confirmed downtrend, not noise.
Overdue: Live-Cooking Shoot 1 was due Aug 14 — 11 days past deadline with no completed event logged; creative pipeline depends on this footage.
GBP actions hit 0 on Aug 23 and Aug 24 (vs a 28d total of 469 and a prior 7d avg ~18/day) — channel_dark signal; cause unknown, possible listing issue.

"BWS - Sales - Muslims" consumed $834.94 of $1,483.97 (56%) in 28d; purchase spikes are clustered (Aug 11: 6 purchases, $1,661 revenue) with long zero-purchase stretches — probable frequency fatigue on a narrow Muslim-audience pool.
GA4 sessions rose 12.95% WoW (last 3 days avg 312 vs prior 3 avg 239) while purchases collapsed — site or checkout friction is absorbing the traffic gain; warrants watching.

suggestions.text: Investigate GBP listing immediately — 2 consecutive zero-action days on a 18/day baseline is a confirmed dark event.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions dropped to 0 on Aug 23 and Aug 24 after averaging ~18 actions/day across the 28-day window. Check that the Google Business Profile listing is live, not suspended, and that phone/directions/web-click tracking is intact. Success = actions return to ≥10/day by Aug 28. Re-check Aug 28.

suggestions.text: Inject at least one new creative into BWS - Sales - Muslims; cap frequency before the narrow pool burns further.
suggestions.monday_update: BWS - Sales - Muslims has taken 56% of 28-day spend ($834.94 of $1,483.97) on a narrow audience, with purchase spikes giving way to multi-day zero-purchase stretches — a classic frequency-fatigue pattern. Introduce one new real-footage creative (facility footage delivered Jul 21 is approved) and reduce existing ad delivery weight by ~20%. Success check: purchases per $100 spend returns to the Aug 11 cluster rate (6 purchases / ~$57 spend) within 7 days of launch. Re-check Sep 1.

suggestions.text: Watch GA4 sessions vs purchases gap for 3 more days before diagnosing checkout friction; do not act on hypothesis alone.
suggestions.monday_update: Sessions averaged 312/day over the last 3 days while purchases hit zero — but the purchase series is so sparse (22 in 28 days) that 3 zero-days is within normal variance. Monitor Aug 25–27; if sessions stay above 300 and purchases remain zero across all 3 days, escalate to a checkout/funnel audit. Re-check Aug 28.
